title: Survey of Women's Choice of Delivery Before Consulting With Her Obstetrician
brief_summary: We are surveying women who have had a previous cesarean section at the time of entry into prenatal care for their next pregnancy about their thoughts related to a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) or repeat c-section.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant Women
* 18 years old or older
* Prior pregnancy with cesarean delivery
* No prior obstetric physician care during current pregnancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* More than one prior cesarean
* Women who cannot read English
study_population: Participants will be selected from the new obstetrics patients in the University of California, Davis Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology department clinics.
